cohort: The study included 53 dichorionic (DC) twin pregnancies with selective intrauterine growth restriction (sIUGR), defined by a birthweight discordance of >=25% and a smaller twin with birth weight below the 10th percentile, delivered between September 2012 and December 2018.
finding: Intrauterine fetal growth restriction (IUGR) was identified as a significant risk factor for newborn respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) in dichorionic twin pregnancies.
birth_weight: Birthweight discordance of >=25% and smaller twin with birth weight below the 10th percentile for sIUGR definition.
gest_age: Exclusion of deliveries below 23 weeks gestational age, with younger gestational age at delivery identified as a risk factor.
